case_metadata.title: HPCL Visakhapatnam Refinery Storage Tank Fire vs Gas Flare
case_metadata.description: Demonstrates normal steady flaring (18-24 MW) escalating into a massive off-stack storage tank fire (320 MW) with baseline violation and critical priority alert.

telemetry_steps.description: VIIRS NOAA-20 detection at HPCL Vizag flare stack (19.4 MW). FRP matches historical baseline median.
VIIRS NOAA-21 pass detects rapid thermal surge to 142.0 MW. Off-stack location detected 280m south of flare stack.
MODIS Aqua & VIIRS pass detects catastrophic peak at 328.5 MW with footprint expanding to 12.4 ha. Stark baseline MAD z-score (14.2).
Thermal suppression underway. FRP decays to 45.0 MW. Footprint stabilizing. Analyst confirms industrial storage incident.
